hook: Your boat here sails between two colours of water.
title: Your boat floats between two rivers
description:
Near Manaus in Brazil, the dark Rio Negro meets the sandy Solimões and the two flow side by side for kilometres. Differences in temperature, speed and density keep them apart for a while. This is the Meeting of Waters.

#Shorts #Amazon #Geography
